verdict.rationale: ReadMe can be driven headlessly through three documented routes: the ReadMe API for controlling docs programmatically, an official CLI (rdme), and Git-based workflows where Markdown and OpenAPI files live in a repo and pull requests serve as the review step. None of the evidence explicitly describes running ReadMe inside a CI pipeline. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline examples), detail on rdme's CI usage and authentication, hands-on or independent corroboration of automated runs.
